claims.title: Global ordered-cycle recurrence with a slow physical-return clock

quoted_fields.interface: The author-derived construction closes all faces for y0=0,y1=(1,1,0),yj=(j,j-1,j-1),2<=j<=k, in the cycle y0->...->yk->0, every k>=3 and fixed positive rates. It proves nonexplosion, irreducible positive recurrence and stationary exponential inventory/activity rewards through one shared physical return contract.
quoted_fields.failure: Complete same-principal family proof, without independent review or priority clearance. General weak-reversibility recurrence remains open. Stationary exponential count/activity rewards and all polynomial physical returns coexist with NO positive exponential physical return moment. No practical crossover; chemistry non-operational.
